units.function: Paperclip's customer-facing company import page: accepts GitHub or ZIP packages, previews files and collisions, configures Agent adapters, submits an asynchronous import job, resumes browser-side watching and optionally activates imported Agents and routines.
units.dependencyDirection: A 1,935-line React page directly coordinates shared portability types, auth/company contexts, five API domains, adapter-specific configuration, ZIP parsing, file rendering, conflict policy, browser persistence, job polling and post-import activation. Domain policy, transport, lifecycle and presentation are tightly coupled.
units.keyDataModels: Portability source/preview/result/file maps, mutable target/collision/file-selection/name-override state, Agent adapter overrides/config values, in-memory import job outcomes, sessionStorage watch handles and client-only activation selections/failures.
units.lifecycle: Select GitHub/ZIP source and target; request preview; derive conflicts/default adapter and file choices; rebuild apply metadata from mutable client state; submit or adopt an in-memory server job; poll indefinitely; refresh company/session/sidebar state; optionally resume each imported Agent/routine through separate client API calls.
units.testAssessment: Focused jsdom Vitest passed 15/15 tests on 2026-08-19. Tests cover default pause, async submit/poll, 409 adoption, transient/permanent poll errors, sessionStorage recovery, partial activation failure, multipart ZIP transport, progress/error panels and compact-result success. ZIP parsing/rendering and Markdown are mocked; tests do not prove archive traversal/decompression limits, auth/tenant authorization, preview/apply digest equality, idempotent durable recovery, cancellation, stable error codes, secrets/Connector rebinding, approval/evidence semantics, accessibility or real mobile behavior.
units.designRationale: Make large company imports survivable across browser reloads and proxy failures, default imported automation to paused, expose package contents/conflicts before applying and let operators choose runtime adapters during import.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs governed, tenant-safe migration where one accountable human reviews and approves an immutable plan, secrets and external identities are rebound explicitly, imports are durable/idempotent and any activation becomes a separate responsibility-bound action with evidence.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT as a server-owned import-plan/job workflow behind Company OS ports and its independent Web. Preserve the default-paused quarantine, source-package browser, explicit conflict review, multipart upload and reload-watch concepts. Require canonical package digest, immutable plan revision, stable codes, persisted job/outbox, bounded retry/cancel/resume, policy and approval gates, secret-free Connector rebinding and a separate activation command with responsibility evidence.
units.responsibilityConflict: The page has no accountable human, purpose, responsibility contract, permission/data scope, risk classification, approval digest or durable evidence. Replace is an ordinary select; imports may partially write; unpause is a checkbox; activation is a sequential browser loop with partial failures and no transactional or audit record.
evidence: 5ca752dc81cfb01f74282e1b562694079e1d0cf1 fix(server): raise company import zip upload limit to 1 GB and make it operator-configurable (#11184)
2026-08-19 focused jsdom Vitest: 1 file / 15 tests passed
securityFindings: Preview and apply are separate requests with no package digest, source revision, immutable plan token or approval binding; apply reconstructs metadata from mutable client state.
An explicit empty file selection becomes undefined, which may collapse to a server default rather than preserving select-none semantics.
Import jobs are retained only in server memory; browser reload can resume watching, but server restart loses the job record and cannot prove or resume partial execution.
Polling has no cancellation, deadline or retry budget; 429, 5xx and network failures can loop forever, while behavior depends on HTTP statuses and English-shaped error bodies.
Replace-existing and unpaused import choices have no authorization explanation, second confirmation, risk policy, accountable-human approval or action digest.
Post-import activation is a sequential client loop over Agent/routine APIs with no transaction, idempotency key, rollback, cancellation, batch record or approval/evidence chain.

All imported Agents default to the current CEO adapter or hard-coded claude_local, coupling portability to role/vendor assumptions and potentially carrying adapter configuration without an explicit secret-rebinding contract.

ZIP extension/non-empty checks and client-side archive expansion do not by themselves prove archive traversal, decompression-bomb, MIME, content or upload-integrity controls; the focused suite mocks archive parsing.
Raw warning/error strings are used as identity and UI contract, hindering stable localization, deduplication, policy handling and audit correlation.
Conflict, adapter and activation state is keyed by slugs/client keys rather than server-issued typed conflict/action identities; cross-kind collisions and stale plan semantics are possible.

Recovery storage is browser/session scoped by selected company and package-derived text, not by authenticated principal plus package digest; multiple imports and cross-device/operator recovery are not durable.
Success can retain only companyId after detailed results expire, losing the entity-level import outcome needed for provenance and responsibility evidence.
The UI repeatedly states reconnecting will not lose an import although the implementation explicitly cannot survive server restart, overstating durability.
